isl500-specialist-neural-v1
Targets: hello, thank_you, yes, no, help, water, teacher, student, where
Data: ISL500-only real videos.
Split: 10 train signers / 2 validation signers / 3 unseen test signers.
Candidates: TCN, BiGRU, Conv+GRU. Best validation model is evaluated on final test signers.
Gate: >=70% top1, >=65% macro F1, >=80% accepted accuracy, >=50% coverage.
